result_field: TransportTiming (only when a nonempty timing object is supplied)
identity: FrameId is the actual frame.Id passed to SignalEngine; NetworkSimulation assigns this monotonically at actual aggregate transmission, distinct from application identity. Ordinal is only an audit row index. FrameId and Ordinal are uint64; time components/sums are exact integer-valued doubles within flintmax.
policy_scope: Receiver callback start/preamble/end only; physical signal fields and PHY/header/ECC formulas, TX/MAC completion, acquisition and scheduler defaults unchanged. Optional mode initializes interval start from actual receive callback Now.
causality: nanoseconds mode rejects scheduled receive start before actual TX; preflight every receiver and record capacity before engine state or event mutation. No clamp.
arithmetic: continuous old operation order: tx+propagation, tx+propagation+preamble, tx+propagation+duration. nanoseconds independently rounds four components then sums exact integer nanoseconds; sum limited to flintmax.
bounded: Omitted always 0; record overflow is an explicit failure before PHY state/event mutation.
record_scope: Preflighted scheduled targets for every non-self receiver attempt, including targets beyond the run horizon. Occluded observations schedule completion only. Records do not claim every target was executed; actual execution is in the normal PHY trace.
